[{"insert":"Strict Bar Dip

The strict bar dip is back in a straight sets format this week. Keep your elbows tracking back, not flaring wide, to protect your shoulders. The 31X1 tempo means three seconds down, a one second pause at the bottom, then drive up, and that pause kills any bounce to make each rep honest. Finish with a max unbroken set at your first working set weight.
"}]
